key.name: keep-focus-on-current-window
key.summary: Keep focus on the current window
key.description: When enabled, newly opened windows are moved without switching focus to them.

key.name: same-workspace-wm-classes
key.summary: Window patterns that share a workspace
key.description: Case-insensitive regular expressions. Windows with matching WM_CLASS, app ID, or title are placed on the same workspace.
